transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Um... I guess I'm just having some trouble at work. I work in retail, and... well, if I'm in the stockroom and I even think there might be a bat, or... or just something flapping around back there... my heart just jumps. I start sweating, and I, uh... I just feel like I need to get out right then. So... yeah. That's why I'm here.
Is it just bats that trigger this reaction, or are you afraid of other animals as well?
No, um... just bats, I think. I don't really mind other animals. Just... them.
How long have you been afraid of bats?
Um... about two years, I guess. Ever since... well, there was this one night a bat got into the back corridor at work. I was on a receiving shift. So... yeah, since then.
Do you feel anxious or on edge in situations that have nothing to do with bats?
No, not really. Just... just the bats.
Do you start feeling anxious before you go into the stockroom, worrying that there might be a bat there?
Um... I don't know. I guess I just... I try not to think about it until I have to go back there. I just want to get my work done and get out.
Do you start worrying about bats when you know you'll be going into the stockroom later?
No, not really. Like I said... I just try to keep my mind on my work. I don't sit around worrying about it before I go in.
Have you ever avoided going into the stockroom because of the bat issue, even when it was necessary for work?

Um... yeah, I guess. I've been, you know, swapping out my closing shifts when I can. And... I usually take the long way around the loading area now. If I absolutely have to go check the stairwell for something, I just make myself do it really fast. I hold my phone out the whole time... I'm just pretty scared whenever I have to be in there.
Do you ever feel anxious when you're not at work or thinking about bats?
Um, no. Not really. If I'm not there, I'm fine. I don't really get worked up about other stuff.
Do you ever worry about encountering bats when you're not at work?
No. Um... not really. Just at work.
When you avoid going into the stockroom, is it because you're afraid of seeing a bat or because you're afraid of having one of those anxiety attacks you described?
Um... it's just the bats. I'm just... I don't want to see one. That's all.
Do you ever feel overwhelmed or anxious when you're in a situation that has nothing to do with work or bats?
No. Not really. Just... normal stuff, I guess. Nothing like that.
Has your fear of bats affected your personal relationships or activities outside of work?
No, not really. I mean... my wife knows I don't like them, but... it doesn't really come up. Just... normal life outside of work.
Has your fear of bats caused you any problems or distress outside of your work life?
No. Um... like I just said, it's... it doesn't really come up anywhere else. I don't run into them outside of that stockroom, so... no.
Has your fear of bats caused you significant distress or problems in your daily life recently?

Yeah, at work. Um... my manager's been asking if I can actually handle being a shift lead. I guess because I keep trading away the closing shifts. I just... I can't do the after-hours checks in the back. So now I'm not "dependable." It's... I don't know, it might cost me the permanent management spot I was trying to get.
Would you say that your fear of bats is currently causing you more distress than the problems it's causing at work?
I don't... I'm not really sure how to answer that. The work stuff is... that's the main issue right now. I just... I really don't want to lose that spot. So, no, I guess. It's just the job.
Are there any activities or situations outside of work that you avoid because of your fear of bats?
No, not really. Like I said, it's just... it's just the stockroom at work. I don't really go anywhere else where they'd be.
Do you think your fear of bats is reasonable, considering how often you actually encounter them or the danger they pose to you?

I mean... I know it's probably not going to hurt me if one did get in the store. But... I don't know. If I see something that even looks like one, or... or just a shadow moving in the back hallway, it's like... my brain just tells me I'm in actual danger. It doesn't matter if it's reasonable or not.
Are you experiencing significant anxiety or distress about your fear of bats when you are not thinking about work or being in the stockroom?
No, not really. If I'm not at work... I don't really think about it. It's just... it's just the stockroom.
Has your fear of bats ever caused you to avoid social gatherings or events outside of work?
No, I don't think so. I mean... I just go to normal places. There aren't bats around, so... it doesn't really come up.
